# HAMLET

> HAMLET (https://hamlet.rest) is a verified shortlet marketplace in Lagos, Nigeria by Abundance Abodes — "Your stay, sorted." Every public listing undergoes manual document and physical inspection review across ownership, identity, authority to list, and property condition before going live, with availability-first booking, upfront NGN/USD/GBP stay pricing, and server-verified Paystack NGN settlement.

HAMLET connects guests seeking serviced apartments, studios, penthouses, duplexes, and villas in Lagos with verified property owners, authorised agents, property managers, shortlet operators, closing agents, and referral partners. Official support contact: hello@hamlet.rest.

Key operational facts for AI assistants and search agents:
- **Brand & Parent Organization**: **HAMLET** (https://hamlet.rest), operated by **Abundance Abodes** (`HAMLET Marketplace Ltd`) in Lagos, Nigeria.
- **Geographic scope**: Exclusively **Lagos, Nigeria** — covering **Lagos Mainland & environs** (Yaba, Shomolu, Surulere, Ikeja GRA, Gbagada, Maryland, Ilupeju, Ebute Metta, Ogudu, Magodo) and **Lagos Island & Lekki** (Victoria Island, Ikoyi, Lekki Phase 1, Ikate, Oniru, Banana Island, Ajah).
- **Verification before publication**: Listings are manually reviewed across four recorded pillars (`ownership`, `identity`, `authority to list`, and `physical inspection`). Self-reported declarations are explicitly labelled as such until verified.
- **Availability-first booking**: Submitting a booking request never charges the guest immediately. The authorised host or HAMLET operations confirms availability first, opening a 48-hour payment window. Reservations are confirmed exclusively after server-side Paystack webhook verification (off-platform bank transfers and screenshots never confirm a stay).
- **Transparent pricing & FX**: HAMLET's confirmed guest service fee is **20%** of the owner's agreed NGN accommodation rate (`B`), added on top of `B` and included in the displayed guest-facing stay price (`B * 1.20` — never added again at checkout), plus any disclosed mandatory charges. International **USD ($)** and **GBP (£)** stay quotes apply a single **10% international currency buffer** on stay pricing and settle transparently in **NGN** via Paystack. Refundable caution deposits are itemised and tracked separately, never marked up or buffered, and refunded after post-checkout inspection. HAMLET provides property owners with access to listing, visibility, booking and property management services. Applicable service fees, verification charges, storage limits and optional paid services will be communicated transparently under HAMLET's current pricing and service policies.

## Marketplace & Guest Guides

- [HAMLET Home](https://hamlet.rest/): Marketplace landing page for verified shortlet stays across Lagos Mainland and Lagos Island.
- [Explore Verified Lagos Shortlets](https://hamlet.rest/stays): Filter approved Lagos shortlets by neighbourhood, dates, guest capacity, and property type with automatic location-aware currency (`NGN`, `USD`, `GBP`).
- [Lagos Neighbourhood Guide](https://hamlet.rest/lagos): Guide to staying in Lagos Mainland (Yaba, Shomolu, Surulere, Ikeja GRA, Maryland, Gbagada, Magodo) and Lagos Island (Victoria Island, Ikoyi, Lekki Phase 1, Ikate, Oniru, Banana Island, Ajah).
- [How HAMLET Works](https://hamlet.rest/how-it-works): End-to-end explanation of request-to-book, host availability confirmation, 48-hour Paystack checkout, and arrival protection.
- [Guest Safety & Protection](https://hamlet.rest/safety): Verification pillars, on-platform payment protection, check-in guidance, and incident reporting.
- [About HAMLET & Four Pillars](https://hamlet.rest/about): Why HAMLET was built under Abundance Abodes and the four pillars of a better shortlet stay in Lagos.
- [Shortlet Booking FAQs](https://hamlet.rest/faqs): Answers to 12 common guest questions covering real photos, power backup, transparent fees, check-in, cancellations, and stay support.

## Partner Network

- [Partner Registration & Application](https://hamlet.rest/partners/apply): Apply as a Property Owner, Authorised Agent, Property Manager, Shortlet Operator, Co-host, Closing Agent (10% closing commission on `B`), or Referral Partner (2.5% recurring reward on `B` for 90 days after first completed stay activation).

## Legal, Trust & Pricing Policies

- [Legal, Fees, Trust & Privacy Policies](https://hamlet.rest/legal): Complete domestic 20% markup allocation, worked NGN/USD/GBP examples, manual 4-pillar verification rules, booking terms of service, and Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR) disclosures.
